title: Bardhaman regional orientation
type: Original editorial SVG schematic; no generated raster geography
geographical_scope: Bardhaman and the adjacent districts of Birbhum, Bankura and Hooghly in West Bengal, India
method: River courses are deliberately simplified and smoothed from sparse visual reference points on the official district administrative map, cross-checked against the official river map. Town markers preserve the relative positions shown on the administrative map. The diagram has no geographic projection, scale, administrative polygons or settlement boundaries. Background colour washes are decorative, not thematic data.

limitations: Not to scale or suitable for navigation.
Names of surrounding districts indicate broad relationships, not boundaries.
Not a map of Aguri settlements, population or territorial claims.
Only three principal rivers and three reference towns are shown; this is not an exhaustive hydrographic map.
